about: Sittings 6a (the classroom and the infirmary, each redone in place from the game's own picture) and 7a (the Courtyard's evening and night, relit from the chosen Courtyard, which is not installed), written early by hand as one file on 11 Oct 2026 at the owner's word ('Can we go on with the next batch of images?'). The prompts are the tool's own (make_redo_workflow.redo_job and prompt_for) from the scratch record in which the three chosen yards are fixed, so the classroom's windows show the School Courtyard as chosen.

7a is the first outdoor relight (plan 5.1). Its night is painted two ways for the owner to choose between: every window dark with only the stone lamps by the gateway and the vending machine glowing, which follows the owner's rulings O38 and O39 for rooms nobody is up in; and the plan's general outdoor night, in which windows and lamps glow warm.

Judge without installing: tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py <place> <a> <b> --dry for the two rooms, and --relight courtyard <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against <the chosen Courtyard> for the three relights; then by eye against the day picture for anything added, and that what stands beyond the gateway is still there.

sentences.courtyard_evening: Change the time of day to early evening: a warm orange and pink sunset sky, and low golden sunlight with long soft shadows. Windows already in the picture catch the light or begin to glow warm; add no new light.
sentences.courtyard_night: Change the time of day to night: a deep blue night sky with stars and a faint moon, and cool blue moonlight on everything, with soft shadows. Every window of the buildings is dark. Only the stone lamps beside the gateway and the front of the vending machine give a small warm glow; add no new light. Everything beyond the gateway and on the hills is still there, as dark shapes against the sky.
sentences.courtyard_night_lit: Change the time of day to night: a deep blue night sky with a few stars and a faint moon, and cool blue moonlight on everything, with soft shadows. Windows and lamps already in the picture glow warm yellow; add no new light.

classroom: Through the windows: the school courtyard below, the library's roof beyond it, and cedars
infirmary: Through the windows: cedar trunks at the forest edge

renders_kept_in: ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early/renders/ (the ten files as ComfyUI saved them on 11 Oct 2026)

install_redo_dry.classroom: A LOOK, B LOOK, both only for the window views, as asked; nothing moved (B 6.8 times sharper than today's picture, A 4.5). The check looked for nothing added ('0 places checked'): the classroom has no keep list yet, so it cannot see what A adds.
install_redo_dry.infirmary: A PASS; B LOOK (two parts of the right-hand side drawn differently; the cot agrees 0.86 with 58% of its edge, against 0.97 and 98% in A).
install_redo_dry.courtyard: all six relights PASS on the fifteen points (none off by a pixel). A relight is not checked for additions, by design.

by_eye.classroom: B is faithful: every desk, the square clock, the notices, and through the windows a long roof below and cedars, as the record says ('the school courtyard below'). A ADDS school bags hanging on four desks and a low bookshelf either side of the teacher's desk, turns the clock round, and shows a school building at eye level across the yard, not below.
by_eye.infirmary: A is the closer: its one addition is a keyboard and a mouse in front of the monitor. B adds cardboard boxes on top of the filing cabinets and redraws the right-hand side.
by_eye.courtyard_evening: both faithful, nothing added; A has the stronger sky and lit windows on the schoolhouse, B a softer sky and a gold rim on the tall cedar. Close.
by_eye.courtyard_night_dark: A is faithful: every window dark, the stone lamps by the gateway and the vending machine glowing, the pagoda, the steps and the hills all still there. B ADDS a notice board and a bench in front of the schoolhouse.
by_eye.courtyard_night_lit: A is faithful, with every window of the schoolhouse and the hall's open front lit warm. B ADDS three benches and strings of lights on the pagoda.

read_11_oct.measured: mean brightness out of 255: classroom A 114, B 118; infirmary A 101, B 96; Courtyard evening A 109, B 112; night with dark windows A 64, B 61 (12 to 14% of it darker than 25); night with lit windows A 85, B 75.
read_11_oct.my_picks: Classroom B; infirmary A; Courtyard evening A (close); Courtyard night with every window dark, version A, which follows O38 and O39 (the windows-lit A is the faithful alternative if the owner would rather the campus looked awake). Put to the owner; nothing was chosen when this was written.
read_11_oct.lessons: The first outdoor relight holds: nothing moved in six of six. Two of the four nights added street furniture (benches, a notice board) and one strung lights on the pagoda although the sentence ends 'add no new light': a night outdoors is read by eye for added benches, boards and lights. A room with no keep list is not checked for additions at all: write the keep list before judging a room redone in place.
